Adapted the core trailmark skill (-> tob-trailmark) onto pyghidra-mcp: retargeted Trailmark's documented v0.4+ engine.augment_binary() binary-graph-JSON import (schema verified against trailofbits/trailmark's own src/trailmark/analysis/binary.py, models/graph.py and models/edges.py source, not invented) to be fed from decompile_function/list_xrefs/gen_callgraph output, with an explicit mandatory confidence field on every calls[] entry (fix round 1, C1: the importer's real default when the field is omitted is 'certain', not 'inferred' as originally stated here - _confidence() in binary.py falls through to EdgeConfidence.CERTAIN when the key is absent; the field is now required and the wording corrected), extending the ai_-prefix/invariant-bracket conventions the ghidra/reva packs already establish on this same server. Preserved upstream's exact reachability-is-not-taint sentence verbatim (references/preanalysis-passes.md pass 4: 'verify data flow manually before claiming it') and its SKILL.md-level Reachability-is-not-taint section, both carried into tob-trailmark/SKILL.md with an added caution for Ghidra-inferred call edges. Documented that QueryEngine.from_graph() (the constructor this workflow uses) does not auto-run entrypoint detection the way from_directory() does - verified against trailmark's own api.py. The entrypoint-annotation workaround (fix round 1, I3) now resolves the entry function's real graph node id via engine._store.find_node_id() first, rather than assuming a bare symbol name works as a dict key - CodeGraph.entrypoints is keyed by node id, and a binary node's id is bin.<artifact_key>:<symbol> (binary.py's _binary_node_id), not the bare symbol; a bare-symbol key would have registered silently and left entrypoint_reachable/privilege_boundary/tainted empty with no error. query-patterns.md and preanalysis-passes.md got an 'on this host' banner rather than a full rewrite, since their query-API/pass mechanics are accurate for a binary graph too - only the entrypoint-detection and complexity-hotspot caveats needed calling out. targetServers: [pyghidra-mcp] because tob-trailmark's adapted body instructs the agent to call decompile_function/list_xrefs/gen_callgraph/list_project_binary_metadata directly (R2 branch 1).
